name: Victron Energy
models: alle med Cerbo GX / CCGX / Venus OS
notes_da: Kræver Venus OS med MQTT aktiveret. Aktiver i Venus OS Remote Console: Settings → Services → MQTT on LAN (plaintext). Find system serial i: System → Serial.
notes_en: Requires Venus OS with MQTT enabled. Enable in Venus OS Remote Console: Settings → Services → MQTT on LAN (plaintext). Find system serial at: System → Serial.
